description: Take surgeons off one of the rep's prospect lists (by id or name). Their note thread on that list goes with them; the account itself stays as it is: where it stands, visits, follow-ups, account notes, tags and the customer mark. The list stays even when empty; deleting a list is done on the site. Use when the rep asks to drop someone from a list, after saying who.
name: remove_from_list
title: Take surgeons off a list
